tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page ground. Night is the brand's home: every screen, slide and social post starts here. Day is for print, documents and certificates only.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Alternate band behind a section, the HUD bar and chapter interludes.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Cards, service tiles, form fields and dialogs, sitting on void or night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders, table rules, dividers and the dashed sightline of the mark. Never as text.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on void, night and panel. 17:1 on void in both themes.

tokens.name: star-2
tokens.usage: Body copy in long passages and card descriptions, one step quieter than star. 12:1 on void (Night), 9:1 (Day).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Captions, mono labels, coordinates, placeholders and the mark's ring. 7.8:1 on void (Night), 6.1:1 (Day).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The guide star. The one accent: primary buttons, eyebrows, the active chapter and the guide star in the mark. Use it once or twice per view. 12.7:1 on void (Night), 5.3:1 (Day).

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill, such as the primary Contact button.

tokens.name: nebula
tokens.usage: Second accent, used sparingly: nebula highlights, one planet in a pattern, a single chart series. Never for buttons or links. 5.4:1 on void (Night), 5.7:1 (Day).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Cool starlight: technology tags, the In development state and code highlights. 12.4:1 on void (Night), 5.0:1 (Day).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Form errors and invalid field borders only.

tokens.name: particle-warm
tokens.usage: Particle palette: warm white stars. Particles live on Night only.

tokens.name: particle-cool
tokens.usage: Particle palette: blue-white young stars and outer galaxy arms.

tokens.name: particle-ember
tokens.usage: Particle palette: orange giants, Saturn's bands and accretion-disk edges.

tokens.name: particle-gas
tokens.usage: Particle palette: hydrogen gas in nebula scenes, mixed with nebula and ice.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.sample: Exploring the Universe. Building What’s Next.
styles.usage: One per page: the opening headline. Scales down to 40px on phones.

styles.name: display-chapter
styles.usage: Chapter titles in the universe journey and cover slides.

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: Section headings, at most 20 characters per line.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Distance and data readouts, with tabular figures.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: From guided telescope observations to engaging school workshops.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a section heading, up to 62 characters wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I enjoy translating complex astronomical ideas into engaging experiences.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Planning and facilitating guided observations for groups.
styles.usage: Card descriptions, captions and field notes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, section labels and buttons. Always uppercase. Amber for eyebrows, dim elsewhere.

styles.name: coordinate
styles.usage: Coordinates, light-travel times and other measured facts. Sentence case, dim.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a tag's icon and text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags, chips and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between gallery tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a credential list or form block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between a section lede and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between sub-blocks inside a section; the HUD bar height rounds to it.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop (72px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and placeholder badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and photo frames. The brand is near-square, like instrument panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, nav items and filter chips only.

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: The active chapter dot and the journey progress line. Night only.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Toasts and dialogs. Cards stay flat.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur of the nav, HUD bar and chapter captions over the particle universe.
